name: Murderers
overview: The Bible clearly condemns murder, affirming the sanctity of human life as seen in the commandments 'Thou shalt not kill' (Exodus 20:13; Deuteronomy 5:17). The seriousness of this offense is underscored by the prescribed penalty of death for one who takes another's life (Exodus 21:12; Leviticus 24:17). Jesus, led by the Spirit into the wilderness to face temptation (Matthew 4:1), reiterates the gravity of murder and its consequences, warning that those who kill face judgment (Matthew 5:21). These passages collectively emphasize God's holiness and justice in upholding the value of life.
